headline: Reserve Bank of India Announces Gold Bond Premature Redemption Price
summary: The Reserve Bank of India fixed the premature redemption price for the Sovereign Gold Bond 2020-21 Series VIII. Investors are eligible for early redemption starting November 18, 2026.
why: Sovereign Gold Bonds are central bank-administered government debt instruments linked to market gold prices, providing an alternative to physical bullion holdings in India.

impacts.name: India Sovereign Gold Bond
impacts.why: RBI established the formal premature redemption price for the SGB 2020-21 Series VIII tranche.
